facts.fact: Botswana signed a Cooperation Agreement on Digital Transformation with Huawei covering, among other areas, AI-powered public security for law enforcement, which President Boko and the police commissioner want deployed (BOPA).

BWA.note: Telemedicine and smart education are named without an AI tool in a public sector system.
Huawei solutions are foreign products; no local AI model, dataset or computing is stated.
